title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
description:
Digital Pre-order BonusPre-order to receive exclusive Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX smartphone and PC wallpapers, plus profile icons, at launch.

If you pre-order the game, you will receive both the Pre-Order Bonus wallpapers and icons, and the Digital Bonus e-book.

Digital BonusA bonus digital e-book is included with purchase, allowing you to immerse yourself even further in the world of Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX.

Featuring character profiles, a wide variety of character facial expressions, chibi-style 3D models, in-game visuals, and more, this e-book is packed with content showcasing the charm of the game's beloved characters.

Об игреYour final year at Duel Academy is officially underway! Select your partner from over 100 visually upgraded characters and conquer your opponents as a Dueling duo! Strengthen your affinity with your classmates and build memories as you study the art of Tag Dueling and prepare for a Graduation Duel to remember! 

Get Your Game On! Classic Dueling is back and rebuilt with over 3,800 cards, including additional fan-favorite cards beyond those featured in the original Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3. Build your Deck, develop unique strategies, and enjoy student life at Duel Academy as you Duel your way to victory.

Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX marks the first-ever Americas debut of Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 content, which was previously unreleased in North and Latin America.

《New Features》
・Unleash your inner HERO! Over 3,800 cards, including additional cards supporting GX-era Decks. 
・Class is in Session Explore, investigate and expand your extracurricular activities with new and renewed mini-games. 
・Duel the World Enter a Casual Duel or Room Match to enjoy both Tag and 1v1 Duels with Online Multiplayer!
・Gallery Mode Reminisce with story scenes from Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE and Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE2.

[About "Yu-Gi-Oh!"]
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that was serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.'s "WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP" since 1996. Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on "Yu-Gi-Oh!" created from the original manga, that has been enjoyed around the world.
description_short: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.
